items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I would go in every night to see Duke's band -- sometimes Duke would be there, he'd be off the stand, and I'd be down at the bar downstairs, and Ben would say come on upstairs and play so Sonny could go home

ctx.x: And Sonny was sick, and I was off for a week or two, and I would go in every night to see Duke's band -- sometimes Duke would be there, he'd be off the stand, and I'd be down at the bar downstairs, and Ben would say come on upstairs and play so Sonny could go home, you know? After their broadcast, after the broadcast.
So this was how you got to play with Duke?
